description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the product surfaces, backend systems, and internal tools that power a reinforcement learning data platform. You will own end-to-end experiences that help AI research teams and external partners create, evaluate, and improve training data.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior.

 - Build workflows that help external partners create, submit, test, and iterate on environments and training data.

 - Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health.

 - Design backend services and APIs connecting task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality review, and reinforcement learning infrastructure.

 - Collaborate with research, operations, and go-to-market teams to ship useful systems quickly, including when requirements are evolving.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of full-stack software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Strong proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js.

 - Experience owning user-facing or internal products end-to-end, from design through deployment.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging.

 - Experience building dashboards, monitoring, observability, or debugging tools for complex systems.

 - Experience with data collection, labeling, annotation, or evaluation platforms, and designing APIs and databases that connect system components.

 - Partner-facing workflow experience is useful. A technical degree or shipped portfolio demonstrating strong technical depth is expected.

 - Strong product judgment and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for qualifying full-time candidates moving to the United States or Singapore.


LOCATION

On-site or remote. The role is associated with the United States; remote candidates should be able to maintain 70% to 80% time zone overlap with San Francisco or Singapore.
